# Refactoring: payments module

## Problem

The payments×orders coupling causes recurring bugs (7 bugs in 3 months in the area) and blocks checkout evolution.

## Measurable goal

Decouple the payments module to enable the recurring payment feature, with the listing response time kept below 400ms.

## Impact analysis

Touches `src/payments/` and the call sites in `src/orders/`.

## Non-negotiables

- The user cannot perceive a change in the checkout flow.
